evidence.quote: In this study, four kinds of Re0.06HfxTa1.6W0.45(TaC)y refractory medium-entropy alloys (RMEAs) were prepared by powder metallurgy process.

evidence.section: 4.2 Oxygen migration and its effect on carbides during SPS preparation
evidence.quote: Initially, the sample was sintered under a pressure of 10 MPa. Following vacuum evacuation, the temperature was rapidly elevated from ambient to 850 ◦C with a 15-min dwell time. The pressure was then increased to 30 MPa while heating to 1800 ◦C at a rate of 100 ◦C/min, followed by a 30-min isothermal hold. Then reduced the pressure and cooled to room temperature.
The ball milling process was protected by argon. The ball milling duration was 4 h, with a rotational speed of 180 rpm and a ball-to-powder weight ratio of 8:1.

the phase composition of the four alloys is BCC matrix phase, MC/M2C carbide phase and oxide phase.
The CH4, C4H5 and C4H10 alloys are dominated by BCC phase, the second phase is M2C carbides with HCP structure (JCPDS card 18 – 1296), and oxide phase.
Among them, CH10 is mainly composed of BCC phase (JCPDS card 04 – 0788), FCC structure MC carbides (JCPDS card 35 – 0801) and oxide (JCPDS card 6 – 318).
